create_DataChannelManager: create a DataChannelManager with a list of channel objects and optional thread count
get_input_with_timeout: call get_input on the manager to collect data from channels with an optional timeout
set_reply_to_channel: call set_reply to send a detached CPU tensor reply back to a named channel
check_channel_membership: use the contains operator to check if a channel name exists in the manager
terminate_all_channels: call terminate to shut down all managed channels and the thread pool executor
